svg.title: TDECQ measurement on the reference-equalized eye
svg.desc: Eye of the optical waveform after the reference receiver and the 5-tap reference equalizer at 100 m. Two shaded time slices 0.04 UI wide at -0.05 and +0.05 UI around the eye center, and three dashed fixed thresholds at P_ave and P_ave plus or minus OMA/3. TDECQ 3.26 dB.
